title: Bucs announce moves to finalize their 53-man roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bucs announce moves to finalize their 53-man roster
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers have officially reached the NFL’s 53-man roster limit ahead of the 2026 regular season. Tampa Bay completed its final round of roster moves Sunday, trimming the preseason roster while also shifting a pair of players to injured reserve with designations to return.
